redistribution_notes: SHIPPABLE. Only the two largest states were verified to exact figures here (California 39,538,223; Texas 29,145,505) plus the national total 331,449,281; the third entry is the residual of the remaining 48 states + DC. The FULL 50-state + DR + PR table is a single small public-domain file (2020 apportionment table, or table P1) and is the trivial DROP-IN to complete this — recommend shipping the full state table rather than this 2-row stub. prob = count/national total.
granularity_notes: State-level marginal (coarsest US geography). County-level (a far stronger QI for re-id) is also fully public domain (Census table P1 by county) but not transcribed here. State alone is a weak geographic QI for a 331M population.
